notice: ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO — synthetic traces. Every value in this file is invented to show the SHAPE of a migration decision. None of it is measured. It is not evidence about any model, any vendor, or any workload.
attach_real_values_here: This file is the single place a real scorecard would attach. Replace the card bodies, keep the keys, and the page renders measured values with no other change. Until that happens the honesty badge stays as it is.

gates_contract.note: The hash is what makes the contract checkable: it pins which bounds were agreed, before anything was run. A verdict quoted without it is a verdict whose goalposts can move.
gates_contract.rule: Gates are checked against the bound of the ninety five percent confidence range, so a passing gate licenses parity within measurement under pre-agreed bounds — never zero quality drop.

chunk_summarizer.label: Chunk Summarizer
chunk_summarizer.verdict_line: Two gates did not clear. No verdict is issued and the canary is rolled back.

headline.name: Cost delta
headline.basis: per call tokens at the synthetic price book

chunk_summarizer.why: The quality range spans zero, so a drop larger than the agreed bound cannot be ruled out. That is a failure of precision, not a demonstrated regression — and it is still a failure, because the contract asks for parity to be shown, not assumed. The biggest saving on the map is the one that did not clear.
chunk_summarizer.next: Widen the sample to narrow the quality range, and re-probe latency on production infrastructure. Re-run against the same gates hash.

field_extractor.label: Field Extractor
field_extractor.verdict_line: All six gates cleared against the bounds agreed before the run.

headline.name: Cost delta
headline.basis: per call tokens at the synthetic price book

field_extractor.why: The entire quality range sits above the bound, so parity is shown rather than assumed. This is the second largest call site on the map, which is why moving it alone is visible on the bill.
field_extractor.next: Serving the candidate. Keep the shadow comparison running for four weeks so a regression shows up as a diff, not as a surprise.

response_drafter.label: Response Drafter
response_drafter.verdict_line: Measurement is in flight. Gates are agreed and not yet evaluated.

headline.name: Cost delta
headline.basis: shadow arm runs off production, so the bill is unchanged

response_drafter.why: An empty card is the correct card for a call site whose measurement has not finished. The gates were agreed first, so the numbers cannot be chosen to fit the answer once they arrive.
response_drafter.next: Let the shadow comparison run to its pre-agreed sample size, then evaluate against gates hash a7f3c1d90e42.

unmeasured_card.verdict_line: No instrument has been pointed at this call site.
unmeasured_card.why: This call site is unmeasured by design. It does not carry enough spend to pay for the measurement, and the map is what tells you that. No verdict is available and none is implied.
unmeasured_card.next: Leave it. Revisit if its spend share moves.
